paper_title: LaSQuE Improved Zero-Shot Classification from Explanations Through   Quantifier Modeling and Curriculum Learning
caption: Classification accuracy on novel real-world classification tasks in .
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates classification accuracy across several models and datasets. The horizontal axis displays a series of labels representing different model configurations and datasets, including "RoBERTa w/o Exp," "ExExt," "LaSQuE (mean)," "LaSQuE," "LaSQuE (syn2real)," "LaSQuE (syn2real + curriculum)," each labeled with a unique color. The vertical axis represents accuracy, labeled as "Accuracy (%)", with a linear scale ranging from 0% to 65%, marked with tick labels at 45%, 55%, and 60%. The bars are sorted from left to right in ascending order of accuracy. The "RoBERTa w/o Exp" bar is white and has an approximate height of 48%, while the tallest bar, "LaSQuE (syn2real + curriculum)," is dark gray and has an approximate height of 62%. The "ExExt" bar is light blue, with a value around 54%; "LaSQuE (mean)" is orange, around 43%; "LaSQuE" is green, around 52%; and "LaSQuE (syn2real)" is purple, around 53%. A legend identifies the color scheme corresponding to each label on the horizontal axis.
